notes.title: Poison and vinegar
notes.body: This lament later shaped Gospel passion narratives. Its original setting remains a Jewish sufferer’s prayer and should not be erased by later Christian reception.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Extreme curses remain lament language, not permission for revenge. Later Christian reception must not erase the psalm’s Jewish voice.
